shortDescription: Poland had a budget deficit of around 151 billion zlotys  ($40.14 billion) at the end of August, state news agency PAP reported on Tuesday, citing the Finance Ministry.The deficit at the end of July was 141 billion zlotys.($1 = 3.7620 zlotys)
